title: Cattle Corridor Agroforestry and Land Restoration
geography: 12 districts across the cattle corridor (Karamoja, Teso, Lango, Ankole)
problem: Deforestation and land degradation across the cattle corridor are driving emissions and collapsing smallholder productivity. Forest cover has fallen to 12.5% of land area against a 2030 target of 21%.
intervention: Landscape-scale agroforestry combining farmer-managed natural regeneration, commercial woodlots, and shea-tree restoration across 180,000 hectares — integrated with soil carbon monitoring and community land-use plans.
ndcTarget: Reduce AFOLU emissions by 24.9% below BAU to 91.8 MtCO₂e by 2030; increase forest cover to 21%

criteria.rationale: Directly targets the AFOLU 24.9% BAU reduction and forest-cover pledge.
0.85 MtCO₂e/yr with established FMNR methodology; strong co-benefits for soil carbon.
Grant-dependent; carbon revenue could cover 30% of operating costs but PPA not yet signed.
MoWE has GCF track record; district coordination capacity is the bottleneck.
E&S screening started but FPIC process with pastoralist communities not complete.
Satellite + ground-truth sampling design agreed with Climate TRACE team.

evaluation.summary: Strong alignment and climate impact. GCF is prepared to move to concept note stage once safeguards and NDA no-objection are in place.
